༄༅/ /gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi mchod phreng 'dod dgu'i mchod sprin bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi mchod phreng 'dod dgu'i mchod sprin bzhugs so/ /

na mo mañdzu badzrā ya/ /dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje mchod pa'i sgo nas mnyes par byed pa'i cho ga 'dod dgu'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rab 'byams zhing gi chos rnams ji snyed pa/ /rab mchog thabs shes rjes su yongs bsgyur te/ /rab yangs gdul bya'i tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs slad/ /rab tu bzhes pa'i khyab bdag de la 'dud/ /gang gi bde stong sgyu ma'i 'du 'god nyid/ /mchod pa'i yul dang byed po byas na ni/ /rnam par rol bas myur du mchog brtsol ba'i// thabs mkhas kun gyi phul de 'dir bshad bya/ /de yang dpal ldan 'dus pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i rnam bzhag rgyas par ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba nas 'byung yang*/ gtso bor 'phags lugs dang 'brel bas de dang sbyar bar bya ba yin la/ 'dir ni rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa sgrub thabs kun bzang du bsdus pa ltar bya'o/ /de yang yul gang la/ byed pa po gang gis/ rdzas gang zhig tshul ji ltar du 'bul ba'o/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud kyi le'u brgyad pa las/ dpag tshad bye ba'i khyon tsam la/ /gru bzhi shin du mdzes pa yis/ /mchod sten rin chen sna bzhi pa/ gsal zhing rang bzhin dri ma med/ /rigs rnams thams cad mchod pa'i phyir/ /shes rab can gyis gnas su bsgom/ /zhes gtso bor mdun bskyed bsgrubs nas de la 'bul ba dang*/ de yang le'u bcu bdun pa nas bshad pa ltar| zhing gi gtso bo bla ma dang tha mi dad dam/ de rigs bdag gi rnam ldan du bzhugs pa byas la 'bul zhing*/ de yang mdun bskyed sgrub pa'i tshe/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid gtso bo'i nga rgyal bya bar gsungs pas/ mchod bya mchod byed tha snyad du'ang ngo bo tha mi dad pa'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo tha mi dad kyang*/ blo ngor tha dad du dbye nas shar sgo'i mdun du 'khod de 'bul ba'am/ le'u brgyad par/ bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas| |mkhas pas mchod pa'i sprin rnams spro/

/zhes dang kun bzang du'ang/ lha mo bcu rang gi lus las sbrul nas/ 'bul bar gsungs ba ltar bya'o/ / gsum pa ni/ le'u brgyad pa las/ mkhas pas utpal/ ('di'i bar du ma dper yig 'bru bdun chad/) sngags bya zhing*/ /dza ti rnam gsum shes byas nas/ / lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /me tog karṇi ka ri dang*/ /ma li ka dang yu ti ka / me tog ka ra bi rar bsam/ /mchod pa thams cad rab tu brtag /zhes pa des mtshon pa'i nyer spyod bstan par bshad la/ lugs 'di'i mkhan po rgyal bas byin gyis/ dza ti gsum ni sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya gsum la bshad do/ /rgyud kyi le'u de nyid du/ mchod pa rnam lnga mchog rnams kyis/ /rtag tu lha rnams mnyes par bya/ /zhes pas ni nyer spyod lnga gsal par bstan no/ /de bzhin du 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga rnams kyis/ /de la mchod pa rgya mtsho tsam/ /zhes dang*/ le'u bdun par/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchod par byed pas mchod par bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ /sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya// de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso/ /dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas| |bdag gi rigs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi skyod pa yi tshul mnyes pa'o/ /zhes pa rnams kyis 'dod yon lnga bstan par ni lugs gnyis ka'i 'grel byed rnams mthun la/ khyad par 'di'i lugs la/ sgra la mi skyod pa dang*/ dri la rin 'byung*/ ro la 'od dpag med/ reg bya don grub dang sbyar dgos pa rgyud du brda tshig gis sbas par 'dod cing*/

/gzugs sgra dri ro la sogs lnga/ /rtag tu sems ni sbyar bar bya/ /'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /gsang ba'i snying po bsdus pa'o/ /zhes pas chos rigs drug pa'i ngo bor byas nas 'bul ba rnams ni/ thabs kyi dbang du byas pa dang*/ drug po de shes rab kyi dbang du byed na gzugs sogs rdo rje ma drug gi ngo bor byas nas 'bul bar 'dod/ 'phags lugs pas gzugs sgra dri ro zhes sogs kyi yul shes rab kyi dbang du byas pa'i 'dod yon lnga nyid bstan cing*/ de bshad rgyud du phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po sogs/ /zhes sogs kyi bshad par 'dod do/ /yang le'u brgyad par/ rin chen na bza' la sogs pas/ /byang chub 'dod pas rtag tu mchod/ /ces pas na bza' dang*/ rin chen 'byung gnas na chung mchog /rin chen sna tshogs mchog gis brgyan/ /bsgrub tshe rab tu 'grub pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /zhes pas phyag rgya dang*/ zhing 'dra rin chen sna bdun gyi/ /mkhas pa dag gi yongs bkang nas/ /dngos grub 'dod pa sbyin pa'i phyir/ /nyin re shes rab can gyis dbul/ /zhes pas rgyal srid sna bdun/ de yang sgron gsal las ni/ ind+ra nī la dang padma rā ga dang*/ bai ḍyurya dang*/ mar gad dang rdo rje rin chen dang*/ mu tig dang*/ byi ru ste bdun nam/ yang na bud med| skyes pa/ 'khor lo/ ral gri/ nor bu/ glang po/ rta rnams su bshad do/ / bdag po'i phyag rgyar mnyam bzhag la/ /sangs rgyas dkyil 'khor dbus dag du| |'dod chags can blos sangs rgyas la/ /reg bya'i sbyor ba dbul bar bya// zhes pas snyoms 'jug gi mchod pa ste de yang dbus su zhes pas/ rang gtso bo las bye nas mchod pa 'bul ba ltar na'ang*/ mchod pa 'di'i dus su mdun bskyed kyi dbus su phyin par mos dgos so/ /bla ma de bzhin gshegs pa ni/ / bdag gi lus dang bshang gcis mchod/ /ces pas lus 'bul ba dang nang mchod bstan la/

mig bzang brtan pa'i blo ldan pas/ khu ba blangs nas bza' bar bya/ /'di ni sngags rnams thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs gi mchod pa ste| |ye shes rdo rje can kun gyi/ /gsang sngags dngos grub 'grub par byed/ / ces pas rang yab yum snyoms 'jug byas pa'i byang sems thob par bston pa'i bdud rtsis mchod pa dngos bsam/ de'i mos pa byed par 'dus pa snga ma rnams bzhed pa nyid bstan to/ /des na phyis kyi mkhas par grags pa gang dag mchod pa 'di nan gyis 'gog pa ni/ sgron gsal du rgyud tshig 'di dngos su gsang dbang bskur ba la sbyar bas 'khrul gzhi byas par zad kyi/ rtsa 'grel gnyis kas mchod par bshad pa dang*/ lugs 'di'i rgyud 'grel mkhan po rgyal bas byin gyi bla na med pa'i mchod par bshad pa dang*/ dri med sbas pas kyang*/ de mtshungs su bshad pa'i lung dang*/ slob ma dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ byang sems dbyung du rung na rgyal ba mchod nas tshogs gnyis myur du sgrub pa'i thabs mkhas khyad par can gyi tshe yang rung dgos shing*/ rgyud kyi rdo rje'i tshig gcig gis don du ma ston par grub pa'i rigs pa dang*/ khas blangs pa dang 'gal ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas/ /ces sogs kyi don| kun bzang du/ pad nang rang snying sa bon 'od rnams kyis/ /gzugs la sogs pa thams cad bkug nas ni/ /yang dag byang chub yid kyi ngo bo la/ /'od kyi dkyil 'khor dag tu bsgom par bya/ /shes rab ba spu re re las byung ba'i/ /'od zer rnam pa sna tshogs rgya chen gyi/ /ma lus nam mkha'i gtos ni kun tu khyab/ /de las blo dang ldan pas rab tu spro/ /'od kyi sgo las nges par byung pa yis/ /yan lag dri med rgyan kun gyis legs brgyan/ /me long pi waṃ dri dang ro yi snod/ /gos dang chos kyi 'byung gnas la sogs pa/ /rim par mtshan pas rnam par sgeg bcas shing*| |rol pa dam pa'i phyag rgya rnams dang ni/

'od kyi snang bas sprul pa sna tshogs pa'i/ mchod pa'i sprin gyis bkod pa kun tu 'phro/ /dngos kun sgyu ma lta bur so sor ni/ /yang dag rig cing 'jig rten lta mkhas pa/ /rtog pa kun las nges par grol gyur cing*/ /mchog tu bde ba bskyed par byed pa'i rgyu/ / gzugs la sogs pa'i lha mo rnams dang ni/ /de bzhin phyi yi dri sogs thams cad kyi/ /kun nas rgyal ba'i dbang po mnyes bya zhing*/ /tha dad kun tu rtogs las nges grol bya/ /zhes pa'i skyed par byed pa'i rgyu/ zhes pa yan chad kyis/ rgyu dang*| rnam pa dang*/ 'dzin stangs dang*/ byed las rnams rgyas par bshad cing*/ tshigs bcad tha mas don bsdu bstan pa'i don/ kun tu bzang mor lag len du gril pa mngon rtogs su bshad pa lta bu ni mchod pa'i tshul lo/ /de ltar na mchod pa 'bul ba la sbyor dngos 'jug gsum mo/ / dang po ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs shing gtsang bar byas te/ /stegs rin po che'am/ shing ngam ras la sogs pa yid du 'ong ba'i steng du/ snod thod pa'am/ rin po che la sogs pa'i nang du/ rdzas chu bzhi'am/ bsang gtor mchod yon nas gtor bas 'grub pas gsum dang*/ nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa/ 'dod yon lnga'am drug rin chen sna bdun/ gos zung rgyan phreng la sogs pa ci 'byor pa g.yo dang sgyu med pa/ gtsang zhing dri ma dang bral ba/ bkod pa g.yas bskor du byas pa'i sgo nas mdzes shing yid 'phrog pa legs par bshams pa rnams/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin legs par byin gyis brlabs shing lha mo sprul nas mchod par gyur zhes pa'i bar yang sgrub thabs ji bzhin du bya'o/ gnyis pa la/ mchod bstod bzlas pa gsum mo/ dang po la phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ bla na med pa dang*/ nyer mkho'i mchod pa'o/ dang po la chu dang*/ nyer spyod sogs dang*/ 'dod yon dang*| rin chen sna bdun/ bkra shis kyi yo byad do/

/dang po ni/ tshigs bcad rnams kyi dus su thal mo snying khar sbyar zhing*/ sngags rnams kyi thog ma'i tshe pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rang ming gi tshe rang rang gi phyag rgya dang*/ mthar lag pa gnyis snying khar snol te g.yas nang du yod pa'i se gol gyi sgo nas kha phyir bstan te spros nas 'bul ba dang*/ g.yas phyi rol tu yod pa'i sgo nas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol dang bcas pas nang du bsdud pa'i mos pa dang*/ lag len kun la byas la/ /dag cing dri med yid 'ong ba'i/ /sngags kyi yon chab mchog 'di dag/bdag gis dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la bka' drin bstsol/ /oṃ āḥhri pra ba ra sa ta ka raṃ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon te/ de'i phyag rgya ni rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye'o/ /de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil bsang gtor rnams dang*/ arghaṃ gyi gnas su pā dyaṃ/ añtsa mā ṇaṃ/ pro kṣa ṇaṃ/ rnams bcug pa ste/ phyag rgya rim pa bzhin| g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur kha 'og tu phyogs pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi skam pas me tog blangs te gyen du phye nas mdzub mo nas rim gyis dgrol ba dang*/ steng du phyogs pas de bzhin du blangs nas 'og tu phyogs pas mthe'u chung nas rim gyis dgrol ba dang*/ khu tshur des ku shas chu blangs te sku la 'thor ba'i tshul bya ba rnams so/ /yang na/ bsil zhing dri zhim dal 'bab lha yi chu/ /pad dkar 'bras bus brgyan pa yid kyi gnyen/ /zag med rgyal ba'i longs spyod mchod yon 'di/ /'jam pa'i rdo rje dgyes pa bskyed phyir dbul/ /zhes pa chu lhag ma gsum la'ang 'don pa spo'o/ / gnyis pa ni/ bshad rgyud rdor phreng nas 'byung pa'i tshigs bcad/ / lha yi me tog dam pa 'di/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes cig/ ces pa'am/

gdong drug gi rgyud las/ 'dzam bu gling dang gling gzhan na/ /me tog tshogs kyis bkang ba yang*/ /stong gsum la sogs de bzhin ste/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /ces pa'am/ kun bzang gi tshigs bcad gong du drangs pa'i don bsdu na/ thabs shes 'od kyis bsdus shing spros las byung*| |zag med bde stong sgyu ma'i rang bzhin can/ /rab mdzes lha mos bzung ba'i lha rdzas mchog /mkha' khyab me tog dam pas mnyes gyur ciga.oṃ āḥ mañdzu badzra/ badzra dhṛka dzi na dzika ratna dhṛka sogs nas/ bighnānta kṛ ta puṣpe tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'am/ spro na mtshan sngags re re la mgor oṃ āḥ dang*/ mjug tu puṣpe sogs sbyar te/ bsdu na tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin no/ /de bzhin du me tog gi gnas su/ bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas te nyer spyod lnga dang*/ rol mo sbyar zhing*/ puṣpe'i gnas su/ dhū pe/ /ā lo ke /gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shabda rnams sbyar/ nyer spyod lnga'i phyag rgya ni spyi dang mthun no/ /gsum pa ni/ thabs kyi 'dod yon so sor 'bul na/ sngar gyi rgyud tshig gong du bshad pa bzhin 'don pa spos te 'bul ba'am/ 'gyur cung zad bcos te/ gzugs la rnam gsum shes bya ste/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad gzhi/ /lha rnams spyan la dbul bar bya/ /de bzhin sgra la/ de nyid/ sangs rgyas mi skyod rdo rje gtso/ /lha rnams snyan la/ dri la/ de nyid/ sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso/ /lha rnams shangs la/ ro la/ de nyid/ 'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /lha rnams ljags la/ reg la/ de nyid/ sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha rnams lus la/ chos la/ de nyid/ sangs rgyas khyab bdag rdo rje 'dzin/ /lha rnams yid la/ zhes pa gzugs sogs thabs rigs drug gi ngo bor byas nas 'bul zhing*/ shes la sbyar ba ni/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las/

phyag rgya'i rnam pa sngon po sogs/ /de bzhin gzugs la dbye ba gsum// gzugs kyi rdo rje mar bkug nas/ /sa snying la ni dbul bar bya/ /de bzhin du/ yang dag glu dang brjod bral dbyangs/ /de bzhin sgra la/ sgra yi/ phyag rdor/ ga bur a kar dza ti sogs/ /de bzhin dri/ dri yi/ nam snying*/ 'o byed pa dang 'jib pa dang*/ /ro drug de bzhin dbye/ ro yi/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la ni dbul/ /rdo rje pad ma yang dag sbyor/ /'o dang 'khyud pa dbye ba gsum/ /reg bya'i/ sgrib sel la ni/ zhes dang*/ phyi yi chos rnams 'di dag kun/ /btags pa dang ni ma btags pa/ /chos dbyings rdo rje yang dag bkug/'jam dpal rdo rje la ni dbul/ /zhes pa rnams las/ thabs kyi drug la| u pā ya/ rū pa/ shabda/ gandha/ ra sa/ parsha/ dharma dhā tu dang*/ shes rab kyi drug la/ pradzñā rū pa sogs sbyar te/ so sor dbul zhing*/ bsdu na/ lo chen skyabs mchog mtshan can gyis/ /gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas// mchog 'gyur de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin du| |gyur pas de bzhin gshegs rigs mchod/ /de bzhin du sgra sogs sbyar nas| de bzhin gshegs rigs kyi gnas su/ rdo rje rigs kyi ni/ rin chen/ padma'i/ las kyi rigs kyi ni/ ces dang*/ rigs rnams mchod/ ces sbyar nas mdzad pa ltar bya zhing*/ chos la ma sbyar ba 'phags lugs kyi dbang du mdzad pa ltar yin la/ 'dir/ chos la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchog gyur rdor sems rigs kyi ni/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin du/ /gyur pas rdor sems rigs rnams mchod/ /ces sbyar ro/ /yang na kun bzang gi don/ nyer spyod du bshad pa'i rkang pa gsum pa la/ rnam gsum rnam snang gzugs kyi rdo rje'i dngos/ /zhes dang*/ mi skyod sgra'i/ rin 'byung dri'i/ dpag med ro yi/ don grub reg bya'i/ rdor sems chos dbyings rdo rje'i dngos/ /zhes dang*/ rkang pa bzhi pa la/

mkha' khyab gzugs kyi mchod pas mnyes gyur cig /ces sogs sbyar ro/ /de drug gi phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje thal mo mnyam par gcer ba me long gi phyag rgya dang*/ pi wang brdung ba'i tshul dang*/ reng bu 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ zhal zas kyi phyag rgya dang*/ na bza' 'bul ba'i tshul dang*/ mthe'u chung gnyis thur du phyogs par rtse sprad*/ ming med dang*/ gung mo phan tshun du mnyam par bsnol/ mthe bong dang mdzub mo rtse sprad nas so sor brkyang pa chos 'byung gi phyag rgya rnams so/ / bzhi pa ni/ bsdu na/ zhing 'di rin chen zhes sogs sngar gyi rgyud tshig gi 'jug tu/ sapta ratna sbyar/ spro na/ zhing 'di/ 'khor lo/ nor bu/ btsun mo/ blon po/ rta mchog dmag dpon rin chen gyis/ zhes sbyar ba re re'i mthar/ tsakra| ma ṇi/ st+ri/ pu ru ṣa/ hasti/ a shwa/ khadga ratna/ zhes sbyar/ rkang pa bzhi pa la| nyin re bdag gis dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes sbyar na bde'o/ /yang na/ skal bzang skye dgu'i dbang phyug sa yi bdag /stobs ldan 'khor los sgyur rgyal dge ba'i nor/ /pha rol stobs 'joms 'khor lo rin po che/ /phul bas chos kyi rgyal srid thob par shog /ces dang*/ rkang pa dang po gnyis la sbyar nas/ dbang gi rgyal po nor bu rin po che/ /phul bas chos ldan re ba kun 'grub shog /zag med bde ster btsun mo rin po che/ /phul bas mi 'gyur bde la rol bar shog / rgyal srid khur 'dzin blon po rin po che/ /phul bas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bskong 'gyur cig/rgyal srid rgyan mchog glang po rin po che/

/phul bas theg mchog bzhon pas bsgrod par shog /bzhon pa zla med rta mchog rin po che/ / phul bas rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs ldan shog /skye dgu'i mar gyur khyim bdag rin po che/ /phul bas gsung rab mdzod kun 'dzin par shog /ces sbyar la/ 'di la ni bdun pa'i sngags gṛ ha pa ti ratna'o/ /de bdun gyi phyag rgya ni/ /rdo rje thal mo rgyab sbyar nas sor mo rnams bsnol ba dang*/ thal mo gnyis kha phyir phyogs pa'i mtheb mdzub gdub bu ltar byas pa'i sor mo bzhi sbyar/ gung mo gnyis rtse sprad pa'i rgyab du sor mo lhag ma me ri ltar gdengs pa dang*/ thal mo gnyis kha sbyar/ mthel bong gnyis rtse sprad de nang du bkug mdzub mo gnyis gung mo so so'i rgyab du kha sbyar ba dang*/ thal mo sbyar ba'i gung mo gnyis gshibs ste bgreng*/ sor mo gzhan rnams phan tshun mnyam par bsnol ba dang*/ g.yon pa'i lag mthil du g.yas pa'i gru mo bzhag ste/ rdo rje thal mo dam por sbyar ba kha nang bkug pa dang*/ thal mo sbyar ba'i mthe bong gnyis rna ba ltar 'greng pa'i mdzub mo gnyis bsnol/ gzhan rnams bshibs te brkyang pa dang*/ thal mo khong stong du sbyar ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya rnams yin la/ snga ma rnams ltar bdun pa dmag dpon du byed na ral gri shubs nas 'byin pa'i tshul du| g.yas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur las gung mdzub gnyis bgreng/ g.yon pa'i nang nas drangs pa'o/ /de bzhin du yo ga nas 'byung ba'i/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /zhes sogs dang/ mdo sdai mngon 'byung nas gsung pa'i/ gser las legs byas sogs kyis 'bul na'ang rung ngo*/ /lnga pa ni/ bsdu na/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar| |rgyal ba rnams dang dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/ /aṣta dra bye maṃ ga la/ zhes dang*/ rtags brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi/

/aṣta he tu maṃ ga la/ zhes sbyar/ 'bring du na/ dri med chos kun gsal ba'i me long dang*/ /g.yas 'khyil chos sgra snyan par sgraug pa'i dung*| |nyon mongs dug gsum 'joms pa'i ghi hang dang*/ /stong gsum rtsi bcud kun gyi snying po zho/ /chos kun dbang du bsdud pa'i li khri dang*/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i tshe 'phel dur ba'i rtswa/ /rgyu rkyen 'bras bur bsdud pa'i bil ba dang*| |bgegs kyi bar chad kun 'dzoms yungs dkar te/ /rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkra shis rdzas/ /rnam brgyad phul bas phyogs kun bkra shis shog /ces dang*/ 'od bzang 'bar ba dpal gyi be'u/ /sprul ba'i 'khor lo sna tshogs 'chang*/ /dpal ldan padma gar gyi bdag /chos kyi rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzug/bum pa bzang po che ba'i mchog khyab bdag chen po rin cen gdugs| |chos kyi dung ste sgra chen ldan/ ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ /de ltar zag med bde ba'i dngos/ /lha yi dga' tshal mdzes byed pa'i/ /bkra shis rtags bzang brgyad rnams kyi/ /mchod pas dge legs cher rgyas shog/ ces bya'o/ /spro na me long ye shes chen po rgya mtsho yi/ /zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad brgyad kyi/ bkra shis ces pa mchod pas zhes par bsgyur zhing*/ ji ltar sngon gyi sangs rgyas la/ /zhes sogs kyis dbul zhing*/ sngags re re la sbyor na/ me long la/ ā darsha/ zho la/ da dhi/ gihaṃ dang*/ dur ba dang*/ bil ba rnams kyi de nyid do/ /big warta 'bring po na/ gi haṃ la go ro tsa na bshad pa'ang yod do/ / dung la shadkha/ li khri la'ang di nyid do/ /yungs dkar la/ sarṣa pa rnams dang*/ dpal be la/ shtī wat+sa la/ 'khor lo la tsa kra padma la de nyid/ rgyal mtshan la dhā tsha| bum pa bzang po la/ bha dra gha ṭa/ gdugs la tstsha ta/ dung la shaṃ kha/ gser nya la su barṇa mat+say rnams la maṃ ga la dang sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa nang gi mchod pa ni| bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu sbyar ba dngos su yod na legs/

med na mos nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbus nas g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis g.yas bskor du lan gsum dkrugs nas blangs te/ kha gyen du phyogs pas smin 'tshams yan chad du gtor te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus te rgyal ba thams cad kyi byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang 'dra bar bltas nas dus gsum du phyogs bcu nas lhags te/ phyag byed pa'i 'os su gyur pa/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dka' drin mtshungs pa med pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i= rje btsun 'jams dpal dbyangs= slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs= mkhas mchog mar me mdzad bzang po= slob dpon kun dga' snying po= paṇa chen tha ga na= mkhas mchog shānti pa= paṇa chen shrad dhā ka ra= lo chen rin chen bzang po= skyang po chos kyi blo gros= dge gshes skyabs seng = rdo rje sra brtan= dkon mchog 'bar= dge bshes dbang rin= 'khams pa sa phug pa shag rdor= rong pa chos dgon= lo tsā ba mchog ldan= bla ma dpal ldan seng ge= kun mkhyen bu ston chos rje= chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan= lo chen skyabs mchog dpal bzang = sems dpa' chen po nam mkha' 'od zer= yang*| bu ston nas/ lo chen byang rtse/ lo tsā ba grags rgyal/ chos kyi rgyal po 'jigs med grags pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sbyar zhing*/ mngon rtogs su bshad pa ltar dkyil 'khor pa'i lha dang yi dam spyi dang*/ chos skyong*/ rigs drugagazhi bdag rnams lhar bsgyur ba la'ang 'bul lo/ /mjug tu bshad rgyud rdor 'phreng nas 'byung ba/ bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog |dkyil 'khor mchod pa bgyid par 'tshal/ /thugs ni brtse bas nyer dgongs te/ /mgon pos mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /badzra a mṛ ta sbyar ro/ /

gsum pa ni/ gzhan nas btsal ba 'am/ snying kha nas sprul pa gang rung gi bu mo yon tan thams cad dang ldan pa'i rin 'byung dang mi bskyod pa gnyis ka'i rigs 'dzin pa/ mā ma kī'i rang bzhin phul bar mos nas/ rin chen 'byung gnas na chung mchog /rin chen sna tshogs mchog gis brgyan/ / dngos grub rab tu 'grub pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas kun la dbul bar bya/ /ku mā rī mu dra sbyar/ de nas rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su gtso bo dang tha mi dad par gyur/ rig ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje mar skyes pa'i lus la rigs lnga'i sa bon bkod pa dang mkha' gsang sbyang ba sogs sgrub thabs ltar byas nas nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ / bzhi pa ni de nas/ rang gtso bo yab yum gyi byang chub kyi sems sangs rgyas thams cad kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i 'byung gnas su gyur pa/ bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar bas mchod par gyur/ shes rab mnyam par sbyar las byung*| |byang chub sems spros de bzhin gshegs/ /ma lus nam mkha' gang ba yi| |bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ /a nutta ra pū dza sbyar ro/ / lnga pa ni/ gos zung lag tu thogs nas tshigs bcad gzhan nas 'byung ba gang 'thad dang*/ sngar nyer spyod kyi tshigs bcad gsar pa la/ me tog dam pa'i gnas su na bza' dam pa sbyar/ badzra wast+ra sbyar/ rgyan 'phreng zung la/ rgyal ba mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin rgyan ldan phyir/ /sogs/ /a laṃ ka ra sbyar/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin grong*/ /yo byad ci 'byor pa yis ni/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa sogs dang*/ ma hā pū dza me*/ sbyar| oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ/ zhes mchod pa'i nga rgyal bzung ngo*/ /nga rgyal bzung ba rnams la snying khar 'khyud pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang rtags brgyad rnams la rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du slangs nas rdzas de dang de'i snod bzung ba'i phyag rgyas de man chad la ni phyag rgya zur pa mi dgos so/

/ gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs dang*/ rgyud phyi mar gsungs pa'i gang zhig gzugs dang tshor ba zhes sogs kyi tshigs bcad gnyis kyis lha bcu dgu dang*/ bsdud dang dga' dang zhes sogs kyis bsrung 'khor gyi khro bo lhag ma la bstod/ rgyud tshig 'di yang lugs 'di la sbyor ba bde bas skabs su bab bo/ /de bzhin du dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs sogs dang*/ mtshan brjod dang de'i 'dud nyi shu la sogs pa dang*/ dus 'khor rgyud kyis ye shes le'u'i mjug tu/ khyod ni rgan yang gzhon nu mtha' dag rgyal ba'i sras po yin yang thog mar dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid/ /bud med sbyor yang tshangs par spyod ldan mchog gi snying rje dag gis 'jig rten gnyen te gshin rje'i dgra/ khyod ni zhi yang rdo rje bzang po che ba'i 'jigs pa 'phrog pa khyod ni rtag tu bdud kyi bdud| khyod ni grol yang 'jig rten 'dir ni srid gsum smin pa'i slad du rtags bzhugs 'jam dpa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ /ces sogs kyis bstod/ de nas rgyun bshags dang sdom bzung gnyis kyang bya'o/ / gsum pa bzlas pa ni/ rnam bzhag thun mong ba rnams dus 'khor mchod phreng du bshad pa las shes par byas la/ dmigs pa thun mong min pa sgrub thabs su bshad pa bzhin byas nas ji tsam 'tshams pa bzla'o/ / gsum pa 'jug ni/ bzlas pa'i mthar phyi nang gi gtor ma dang sbyin sreg sogs byas/ bdag 'jug dbang bskur sogs dang 'brel na de dag byas pa'i mjug tu/ btang rag gi mchod bstod rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar ba'i mthar dge rtsa rdzogs byang du bsngo ba ni/ rdo rje can zhabs bla ma'i bka' drin las/ /gang shar stong par rtogs pa'i bzung rnam nyid/ /bde chen lha skur shar ba'i thabs mkhas kyis/ /'jam dpal rdo rje dgyes pa bskyed pa'i thabs// de ltar dgyes pa'i dge dang rang gzhan gyis/ /dge tshogs ma lus gcig tu bsdoms pa'i mthus/

/'gro kun thun mong lam gyis rgyud sbyangs nas/ /lam mchog rdo rje theg pas bsgrod par shog /ces dang kun bzang du/ lam gyis rten dang gnas kyi mtshan nyid bsrungs pa'i tshigs bcad kyis tshig mtha' 'don pa bsgyur na/ dal 'byor 'di ni shin tu g.yo ba dang*/ /'jig rten skye bo dam pa 'phrad rnyed dka'/ /de bas shes rab thabs la gzhol ba yis/ /yid la byas pa'i chos de sgrub par shog /de yang sngags pas snying rje'i stobs kyis ni/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni brtan po dang*/ /gtong ba la sogs yon tan rnams kyis brgyan/ /zab mo'i tshul dag la ni lhag par mos/ /dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga yis/ /rang gi dbang bskur phun sum tshogs ldan zhing*/ /cho ga bzhin du rjes gnang thob nas ni/ /blo dang ldan pa'i rang sngags mnyes byed shog /la lar dri med chu ni phun tshogs shing*/ /shing mchog mdzes pas rnam par brgyan pa yi/ /ri bo'i phyogs gcig tu ni bcom ldan 'das/ /'jam dpal dbyangs zhes bya ba 'grub par shog/ces dang*/ sgrub thabs mtha' dag gi don bsdu na/ zhing mchog spyan sngar bsags sbyangs thabs mkhas kyis/ /rlabs chen bsod nams myur du rdzogs gyur te/ rnam thar gsum gyis spros kun 'od gsal du| |bsdus pas 'chi srid chos skur bsgyur bar shog /de las rdo rje'i 'bru gsum thabs shes bcas/ /mkhar ngos legs shar snod bcud zhing sbyong ba'i// rgyu yi rnal 'byor rdzogs mthar de nyid kyang*/ der bzhugs bar do longs skur 'khyer bar shog /de dag zhu ba'i theg le 'od gsal zhugs/ /tshad med glus bkul mtha' yas 'gro ba'i slad/ /sprul skur bzhengs pa'i phung khams yong rdzogs pas/ /rgyu mthun bsnyen pa chung ngu mthar phyin shog /de yi mig sogs dbang po rnam pa drug /rang rang lha sku phra mor yongs rdzogs pas/ /rdo rje skye mched don kun 'jug pa yi/ /rnam smin nyer sgrub chung ngu mthar phyin shog/shin tu phra ba'i sgo gsum mi gshigs pa/

/rgyal ba kun gyi rdo rje rnam gsum du/ /myur du sgrub pas thabs mkhas bla med kyis/ /byed 'bras sgrub pa chung ngu mthar phy-in shog |sku gsum sgrub byed sems dpa' gsum brtsegs rdzogs/ /chos sku'i byed pas phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yis/ /dbang bskur dri ma kun sbyangs gtsug tor grub| |bral 'bras sgrub chen chung ngu mthar phyin shog /tshul de yum dang 'khor la'ang sbyar ba yis/ /bsnyen rdzogs 'bring dang chen po yongs rdzogs shing*/ / mchod bstod kyis mnyes rnal 'byor rnam gnyis kyis/ /bying rgod rgyang bsring bzlas brjod mthar phyin shog /rags snang gsal brtan dang po'i las can dang*| |phra mor gsal snang mthar phyin ye shes babs/ /der yang brten pa thob pas ye shes la/ /cung zad dbang thob bskyed rim rdzogs par shog /mdor na tha mal rnam rtog ma rtogs pa'i/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal zhes bya gzhan med pas| |de dang rnam pa 'gal bar 'gyur ba'i sems/ /de ni mngon sum nyid du rtogs par shog |ces pas bskyed rim dang*/ de nas snying ga'i dhū tir thig le'i nang*/ /gsal rdzogs dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i thugs kar yang*/ /de gsal dus sogs rtags mtha' dga' ba rdzogs/ /mi shig thig le'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin shog /de nyid gsang ba'i sna rtser phab nas kyang*/ /de bzhin bsgom pas mchog dga' yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /nor bu'i thig le'i mthar son de gnyis kyis/ /ma lus thig le'i dbang du bsdu bar shog /gdong gis sna rtser rlung gdangs 'od zer lnga/ /rdo rje gsum du bsgyur bas khyad dga' rdzogs/ / sprul pa'i thig le'i rnal 'byor mthar phyin nas/ /ma lus rlung la dbang bsgyur thob par shog /slar yang snying kha'i thig ler spro bsdu yis/ /snang bcas dang ni rjes gzhig goms pa'i mthar/ /spros kun rim kyis thim pa'i 'od gsal las| |zab gsal sgyu ma'i lus su ldang bar shog /de nas spyod pa gsum gyi thabs mkhas kyis/

/slob dang mi slob zung 'jug rang bzhin can/ /bslu med sku dang 'bras bu'i sku rdzogs te/ /rdzogs rim ye shes sku rnams mngon 'gyur shog |ces pa la sogs pa thun mong dang thun mong min pa'i smon lam rgyas par byas nas/ dkyil 'khor la bskor zhing yig brgya bzlas/ gang yang bdag blo rmongs pa yis/ /nyes byas cung zad gang bgyis pa/ /gang phyir lus can skyabs yin phyir/ /mgon khyod de kun bzod par mdzod/ /ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang*| |gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas/ /'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs/ /zhes pas bzod par gsol/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab/ sgrub mchod zhag sbrel du byas pa'am/ ras bris sogs yin na brtan bzhugs bya/ de lta min na dkyil chog tu bshad pa bzhin bsdus la| rab 'byams skye dgu'i dge legs ma lus pa/ /gcig bsdus dpal ldan 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /mkha' ngos 'gengs pa'i rnam rol mtha' yas kyis| |shis brjod dge legs bstsaul ba de ltar ro/ /phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid chos sku'i gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga longs sku gnas 'og min nges pa lnga ldan/ sprul sku gnas o rgyan rdo rje 'chang chen po'i pho brang du/ sku gsum gyi 'khor nyid kyis sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor dang sa bcu'-i byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ chos rgyal iṇḍa bhu ti 'khor bcas kyis dbus su/ dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i legs bshad kyi rnga sgra chen po rgyun mi chad par sgrogs par ston pa'i yan lag bdun ldan gyi rdo rje 'chang chen po dang*/ de nyid kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'phrul rgya bod paṇa grub kyi rnam par byon pa'i bla ma dam pa thams cad kyi bkra shis dang dge legs kyi 'byor pas khyed cag skye dgu thams cad rtag tu skyong bar gyur cig /dpal ldan khyab bdag byang chub sems rdo rje/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs dang de sras ye shes zhabs/

/mar me mdzad sogs bla ma mchog rnams kyis/ /khyed la dge legs mtha' dag deng der stsaul/ / rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag 'jam pa'i dbyangs byang chub kyi sems rdo rje dang*| rdo rje mi skyod pa dang*/ rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad dang*/ rdo rje rin chen dpal dang*/ rdo rje dpag tu med pa dang*/ rdo rje gdon mi za bar grub pa dang*/ de dag la sogs pa nam mkha'i dbyings thams cad dang mnyam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes lha dang*/ /lha mo'i rnam par snang bar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog du bzhugs pa thams cad kyi bkra shis sogs/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ /'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa po| |dam tshig chen po de nyid mkhyen/ /dbang po bsam pa mkhyen mchog gi/ bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes sku/ /gtsug tor chen po tshig gi bdag /ye shes sku ste rang byung ba/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bkra shis shog

/tshogs gnyis tshogs ni bsags pa po/ /zhes pa nas/ khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi bkra shis shog /rgyud sde rdo rje'i tshigs sum khri gsum stong gi rtsa ba/ mdo sde chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gi snod dam pa/ rgyud kyi rgyal po/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa bshad bya rjod byed mtha' drug dang tshul bzhis bcings shing brjod bya rdo rje bzhi dang rim pa lnga'i bdag nyid/ 'chad byed rgyan bdun gyis sgrol bar bya ba'i lung dang rtogs pa'i chos dkon mchog thams cad kyi bkra shis sogs dang*/ don zab don ni rgya che zhing*/ /zhes pa nas| yang dang yang du gsungs pa gang*/ /dam pa'i chos kyi bkra shis shog / rgyud kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos 'dzin pa'i gang zag utpal dmar po lta bu dang*/ pad dkar lta bu dang*/ pad ma dmar po lta bu dang*/ tsan dan lta bu ste/ tshogs bshad kyi yul du gyur pa bzhi dang*/ rin po che lta bu yon tan yongs su rdzogs pa'i sgo nas slob bshad kyi yul du gyur pa gcig ste/ gang zag lngas bsdus pa'i sgrub pa po la sogs pa dge 'dun dkon mchog thams cad kyi sogs/ 'phags lam shin tu mtho la gnas/ /dar ba chen po chos kyi tog /'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus gcig /gnas brtan rgan po skye dgu'i bdag/mgo zlum brtul shugs chen po 'chang*/ /tshangs par spyod pa brtul shugs mchog /dka' thub mthar phyin dka' thub che/ /dge 'dun rnams kyi bkra shis shog /chos shes bkra shis bkra shis 'byung*/ /zhes pa nas/ mchog tu dga' ba'i grags bdag dpal/ /bkra shis ma lus cher rgyas shog/ces dang yang na/ /dpal ldan mi shes kun spangs dang*/ /yid kyi rol pa sogs gsum gyi mtha'i tshig bkra shis su bsgyur la dbyangs dang bcas par brjod do// 'di yang 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sbyar ba ste gzhan gnyis la'ang 'don pa ci rigs su bsgyur ro/

/dpal ldan 'dus pa ye shes zhabs lugs kyi/ /dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i chog ga yid 'phrog 'di/ /lam 'dir 'dun pa'i slaub mas bskul nas sbyar/ /dge bas 'dus pa'i lam bzang dar rgyas shog / ces pa 'di yang shākya'i dge slong shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rab byung gi lo nag pa zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi bzang po gsum pa'i nyin chos 'khor sgang du sbyar ba shubhaṃ/ chos 'khor sgang gi gzims khang nas/ /shing pho rta la spar du bsgrubs/ /yi ge pa ni tshul khrims 'phel| |spar mkhan chos kyi bzang pos bskos// // maṅga laṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ stag tshang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen gyi bka' 'bum/gsang 'dus 'jam rdor gyi mchod phreng 'dod dgu'i mchod sprin/ -PAGE 364--PAGE 363-- PAGE 359-
